raw_segments.text: Amelia, good morrow, good lieutenant, I am sorry for your displeasure, but all will sure
The General and his wife are talking of it, and she speaks for you stoutly.
The Moor replies that he you hurt is of great fame in Cyprus and great affinity, and that
in wholesome wisdom he might not but refuse you.
But he protests he loves you and needs no other suitor but his likings to take the safest
occasion by the front to bring you in again.
